SELECT count(*) n, count(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) d, count(DISTINCT (f.receipt_id, f.line_no)) d2, min(f.sale_date) mn, max(f.sale_date) mx, sum(f.quantity) q, sum(CASE WHEN f.quantity<=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) nonpos, sum(CASE WHEN f.staff_purchase_flag THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) staff, count(DISTINCT s.store_id) stores
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
WHERE s.store_id=102 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27'

SELECT cp.sku, cp.product_name, cp.category, cp.subcategory, sum(f.quantity) units_sold,
  sum(CASE WHEN p.category='ZZ Test' THEN f.quantity ELSE 0 END) test_units,
  sum(CASE WHEN f.staff_purchase_flag THEN f.quantity ELSE 0 END) staff_units,
  count(DISTINCT p.product_name) names
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku=p.sku AND cp.is_current
WHERE s.store_id=102 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27'
  AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY units_sold DESC LIMIT 8

WITH s AS (SELECT sum(f.quantity) q, count(*) n FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key WHERE s.store_id=102 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27'),
r AS (SELECT sum(units_sold) u, sum(receipts) rc, count(*) days, sum(net_sales_before_returns) nsb FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE store_id=102 AND business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27'),
n AS (SELECT sum(f.net_amount) nets FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key WHERE s.store_id=102 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27'),
ret AS (SELECT cp.sku, sum(r.quantity_returned) rq FROM fact_return_line r JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.product_key=f.product_key WHERE s.store_id=102 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27' AND cp.sku IN (101624,101778,102244,103670,102233) GROUP BY 1)
SELECT 'ctrl' k, CAST(s.q AS VARCHAR) a, CAST(r.u AS VARCHAR) b, CAST(s.n AS VARCHAR) c, CAST(r.days AS VARCHAR) d, CAST(n.nets AS VARCHAR) e, CAST(r.nsb AS VARCHAR) f FROM s,r,n
UNION ALL SELECT 'ret', CAST(sku AS VARCHAR), CAST(rq AS VARCHAR), '', '', '', '' FROM ret
